deviations.from: no case-study farms named in the plan
deviations.to: Hardap Irrigation Scheme (farm/agricultural system) and the Sahel (food shortage region) chosen
deviations.why: Both are real, at the right scale, and fact-light enough to state confidently with rounded figures: Hardap Dam completed 1963 on the Fish River south of Mariental with roughly 1 100 irrigated hectares; the Sahel droughts of 1984 and 2010-2012 with over 18 million at risk in 2012. The Sahel supplies the contrasting kind of case to Namibia's setting.
